questions.q_en: The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS), launched in 2021, aims to foster innovation and support startups at the initial stage. Which of the following does not fall under its primary objectives?
questions.solution_en:
• The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) scheme focuses on providing financial assistance for product trials, prototype development, and market entry. Skill development is not a primary objective of this scheme.

Further Insight:

• Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)

• Launch Date: April 1, 2021

• Aim: Provide financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry, and commercialization.

• Main Features:

○ Targets startups in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.

○ Maximum grant: ₹50 lakh per startup.

○ Objective: Strengthen the startup ecosystem in India, reduce the risk at the idea stage, and create job opportunities.

questions.q_en: Which component of the Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM AASHA) is focused on providing assured price deficiency payments to farmers?
options_en: Pilot of Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS)

• MIS is not a part of PM AASHA.

• Launch Date: September 2018

• Aim: Provide remunerative prices to farmers for their produce.

• Main Features:

○ Components: Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS), Pilot Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS).

○ Focuses on procurement of pulses, oilseeds, and copra.

○ Supports farmers by ensuring MSP (Minimum Support Price) payments.

questions.q_en: Mission Sagar, initiated in May 2020, primarily focuses on providing aid to which region during crises?
questions.solution_en:

Further Insight:

• Mission Sagar

• Launch Date: May 2020

• Aim: Strengthen ties with Indian Ocean Region (IOR) countries during crises, particularly COVID-19.

• Main Features:

○ Part of India's maritime diplomacy initiative.

○ Provides medical supplies and humanitarian aid to Indian Ocean countries (like Maldives, Seychelles, and Mauritius).

○ Reflects India's policy of Security and Growth for All in the Region (SAGAR).

questions.q_en: Under the NIRVIK Scheme (Niryat Rin Vikas Yojana), which of the following is not a key objective?
options_en: Simplifying loan procedures for small exporters

• Launch Date: February 1, 2020

• Main Features:

○ Provides insurance coverage up to 90% of the loan amount.

○ Reduces insurance premium rates for small exporters.

○ Ensures quicker and easier loan disbursal to exporters.

○ Focus on promoting Indian exports globally.

○ Promotes financial inclusion by enabling villagers to use property as collateral.

○ Aims at reducing land disputes.

○ Joint initiative of Ministry of Panchayati Raj and state governments.

questions.q_en: The One Nation One Ration Card Scheme (ONORCS) provides which of the following key benefits?
options_en: Allows portability of ration cards across India
Provides free food to all BPL families
Ensures direct cash transfers to beneficiaries
Links all government welfare schemes with ration cards
questions.solution_en:
• The One Nation One Ration Card Scheme (ONORCS) enables beneficiaries to access their ration entitlements across India, regardless of where they are.

Further Insight:

• One Nation One Ration Card Scheme (ONORCS)

• Launch Date: Implemented in phases since 2019

• Aim: Ensure nationwide portability of ration cards under the Public Distribution System (PDS).

• Main Features:

○ Allows beneficiaries to claim their entitled food grains from anywhere in India.

○ Especially beneficial for migrant workers.

○ Integrated with Aadhaar to ensure transparency and reduce leakages.
